task: Appeal CR005h numerical controls and adjudicate the frozen per-carrier GW candidate ledger
authorization: User approved the per-carrier Starbreaker campaign and necessary freeze work on 2026-07-20.

appealed_items: G08 static and isotropic zero controls

corrected_authority_control.rule: Require exact equality to the sealed CR005d primary verdict, not the erroneous CR005h prefix PASS_CONTINUOUS_FLOW.

corrected_numerical_controls.derivative_operator: The exact sequential numpy.gradient edge_order=2 operator used by CR005h.
corrected_numerical_controls.linearity_primary: For every one of 96 scenarios, max_abs(D^3(sum_i Q_i) - sum_i D^3(Q_i)) must not exceed the frozen roundoff envelope.
corrected_numerical_controls.linearity_power_guard: For every scenario, the relative integrated-power difference between the two linear orderings must be <= 1e-6.
corrected_numerical_controls.static_primary: The aggregate static quadrupole must be constant to <= 64 machine epsilon relative residual before differentiation.
corrected_numerical_controls.isotropic_primary: The six-axis aggregate quadrupole must cancel to <= 64 machine epsilon relative to the summed individual quadrupole magnitude before differentiation.
corrected_numerical_controls.synthetic_derivative_guard: Third-derivative residuals for static and isotropic controls must lie inside the same frozen roundoff envelope.
corrected_numerical_controls.rationale: A third finite difference amplifies harmless floating-point residue by a factor proportional to grid_intervals cubed; quadrupole-level symmetry plus an a priori operator-norm envelope tests the scientific zero without demanding literal floating zero after amplification.

adoption_rule.custody: The complete CR005h release manifest and all manifest-listed files must hash-match.
adoption_rule.candidate_integrity: The carrier ledger, slot table, and occurrence shortlist must be byte-identical to CR005h.
adoption_rule.control_integrity: All corrected authority, linearity, static, isotropic, inventory, and physical-claim firewall gates must pass.
adoption_rule.result: If all adoption gates pass, adopt and freeze the unchanged CR005h per-carrier ledger and its existing candidate classifications.

interpretive_boundary: Adoption validates an internal unit-weighted quadrupole-source attribution. It does not identify gravitational-wave material, physical strain, luminosity, seconds, signal speed, or detector visibility.
